description: A full remake of the second FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO game. Explore Minakami Village, protect Mayu, uncover the forbidden ritual, and repel spirits using the Camera Obscura. description_short: A full remake of the acclaimed Japanese horror adventure following twin sisters Mio and Mayu Amakura in the haunted Minakami Village.
description_ar: إعادة صنع كاملة للجزء الثاني من سلسلة Fatal Frame / Project Zero. تتبع القصة الشقيقتين التوأم ميو ومايو داخل قرية ميناکامي المسكونة، مع الاعتماد على Camera Obscura لمواجهة الأرواح وكشف أسرار الطقس المحرّم. النسخة الجديدة تعيد بناء الرسوم والصوت والتحكم وتضيف مناطق وقصصًا جانبية وميكانيكيات جديدة.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode

notFitFor: Players uncomfortable with intense horror themes

gameplayPillars.title: Camera Obscura Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Photograph hostile spirits at the right moment, manage positioning and use Focus, Zoom and filters to maximize damage and control encounters.

gameplayPillars.title: Haunted Exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Search Minakami Village through dark homes, shrines, passages and new areas while following traces of the village's forbidden ritual.

gameplayPillars.title: Twin-Sister Bond
gameplayPillars.description: The remake adds a Hold Mayu's Hand interaction and expands moments centered on Mio and Mayu's relationship.

gameplayPillars.title: Remade Presentation
gameplayPillars.description: Characters, environments, lighting, sound and controls are rebuilt for modern hardware while preserving the original story structure.

worldSummary: Minakami Village exists in an endless night shaped by a catastrophic forbidden ritual. Mio searches for Mayu through abandoned homes, shrines and dark paths while spirits replay fragments of the village's tragic past.

storyChapters.title: Lost in Minakami Village
storyChapters.body: Twin sisters Mio and Mayu Amakura become trapped in an abandoned village that appears to exist in an endless night.

storyChapters.title: The Crimson Sacrifice
storyChapters.body: Clues reveal a forbidden ritual and the tragedy that left the village filled with vengeful spirits.

storyChapters.title: Together, Always
storyChapters.body: Mio's search for Mayu and the sisters' bond become inseparable from the mystery of the village and its past.

faq.q: Is this a remaster or a full remake?
faq.a: It is a full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly, with rebuilt visuals, audio, controls and gameplay systems.

faq.q: Does the Switch 2 version support Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. Arabic language support was added to Nintendo Switch 2 with version 1.04.00 on June 22, 2026.

faq.q: How does it run on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: The official platform specification lists up to 1080p output at 30 FPS; resolution can temporarily decrease.
Yes. It is a single-player horror adventure.

faq.q: What is included in Digital Deluxe?
faq.a: The full game, Digital Art Book, Digital Soundtrack and several cosmetic/accessory bonuses.

faq.q: Does it use a Game-Key Card physically?
faq.a: Physical-format details vary by region. The Nintendo Switch 2 product should be checked against the exact regional physical release before purchase.

verdictSummary: A strong modern reconstruction of one of the genre's most distinctive horror games. Its atmosphere, sound and Camera Obscura gameplay remain the main strengths, while the 30 FPS cap is the main technical limitation on Switch 2.
verdictPros: Strong narrative focus on Mio and Mayu
verdictCons: Switch 2 version is capped at 30 FPS
No HDR support on Switch 2 according to official platform comparison

reviews.quote: Generally favorable critical reception with strong praise for atmosphere, visuals and horror presentation.
Critics broadly praised the remake's atmosphere and presentation while noting some legacy clunkiness.
Player-facing aggregate data lists an 8.0 user score alongside critic aggregates.
